# CHUM — A Tribute to Phish

> San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute and improvisational rock/jam band active since 2010 (117+ shows, 200+ songs), performing Phish's intricate compositions alongside 70+ classic rock, funk, progressive rock, Grateful Dead, and new wave covers across Northern California and the West Coast.

Founded in 2010 in the San Francisco Bay Area, Chum is one of the longest-running Phish tribute acts in the United States. The 4-piece band can be booked for either a deep-cut multi-era Phish tribute show (1.0 through 4.0) or a high-energy crossover classic rock, funk, and jam-band set tailored for mixed crowds at clubs, theaters, breweries, wineries, festivals, corporate conferences (including Dreamforce), stadiums (Oakland Ballers Stadium), boat cruises, weddings, and milestone private parties.

Lineup: Eric Ingersoll (Keys & Vocals), Chris Detrick (Guitar & Vocals), Chad Kimner (Bass & Vocals), and Alex Bowman (Drums & Vocals), with occasional guest appearances on guitar from Sweden by Eric Schiff. In memory of keyboardist and vocalist John Greene (March 2014 – July 2025).

Crossover cover artists in Chum's 200+ song repertoire include Talking Heads, Grateful Dead, The Rolling Stones, The Beatles / John Lennon, Led Zeppelin, David Bowie, Pink Floyd, The Who, Frank Zappa, Little Feat, Boston, The Allman Brothers Band, Stevie Wonder, ZZ Top, The Cars, The Velvet Underground, Jimi Hendrix, Paul Simon, Warren Zevon, Ween, TV on the Radio, Bob Marley, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard.

Flagship venues and events played include Great American Music Hall (SF), The UC Theatre (Berkeley), The Chapel (SF), The Catalyst (Santa Cruz), Terrapin Crossroads Grate Room (San Rafael), Crystal Bay Casino (Lake Tahoe), Cornerstone (Berkeley), Felton Music Hall (Felton), Moe's Alley (Santa Cruz), HopMonk Tavern (Novato & Sebastopol), Boom Boom Room (SF), Brick & Mortar Music Hall (SF), 19 Broadway & Peri's (Fairfax), Ivy Room (Albany), Crazy Horse (Nevada City), Saint Rocke (LA), Dreamforce, Oakland Ballers Stadium, and Shakedown at Tuscany Suites (Las Vegas Phish Sphere After-Parties).

Booking inquiries: nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com (No Brainer Productions). General band contact: chumphishtribute@gmail.com. Serving the SF Bay Area, Santa Cruz, Sonoma/Napa Wine Country, Sacramento/Foothills, Lake Tahoe, and the West Coast.
